tools.name: list_targets
tools.description: List permitted SSH targets and workspace IDs. Credentials remain on the MCP host.

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Create a persistent Bash session using the MCP host SSH configuration. Reuse clientRequestId after transport errors.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List only sessions owned by the authenticated principal.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Get shell state and last confirmed cwd; broken shells must be replaced.

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close an idle session. Cancel a running command explicitly first.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Submit a non-interactive command in the SAME Bash shell, preserving cd/export/source. HTTP disconnect does not cancel an admitted job. Query commandId/clientRequestId; do not blindly retry. Nonzero exitCode is program failure, unknown means uncertain execution.

tools.name: get_command
tools.description: Get command state by commandId OR by sessionId plus clientRequestId. Never infer success from a missing exit code.

tools.name: read_output
tools.description: Read collected stdout/stderr with byte cursors. base64 is byte-exact; content is a UTF-8 preview. outputComplete=false means running, truncated or uncertain.

tools.name: cancel_command
tools.description: Terminate the remote managed worker process group. Shell state is lost. Returns unknown if termination cannot be confirmed.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List remote workspace files, never local client files. Symlinks cannot be followed.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a remote UTF-8 file up to 1 MiB and return its SHA-256 version for patch conflict detection.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff on the remote workspace. expectedVersions maps every patch path to its read_file hash (null for new files). Reuse request ID on disconnect. No rename, binary or symlink editing. Multi-file errors can return partial_apply.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Read remote Git status scoped to this workspace.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Read remote unstaged changes in the registered workspace. Does not commit or push.
